title: The Pod: Pod -> ground station JSON contract
description: v1 (signed off in P0-4 by all four agents, 2026-11-21). JSON form of shared/pod_msgs.h v1 as sent by pod-uplink to the ground station. Field names match pod_event_t and pod_heartbeat_t exactly; additions are marked 'JSON only'. Changes go through the contract change process in AGENTS.md section 6. Conventions: all times are Unix wall-clock milliseconds (*_ms); CLOCK_MONOTONIC *_ns values never leave the Pod. Unknown extra fields must be rejected by the ground station (additionalProperties false) so typos surface immediately. PRIVACY: there is no person species; the ground station rejects 'person'.

pod_id.description: Matches pod_event_t.pod_id (POD_ID_LEN 16 incl. NUL, so at most 15 chars). Example: 'pod-01'.

seq.description: Per-pod counter, starts at 1, +1 per record, never reused.

visit_event.description: One animal visit. JSON form of pod_event_t. (pod_id, seq) is the idempotency key: the ground station stores the first copy and ignores repeats.

t_end_ms.description: Must be >= t_start_ms (checked by the ground station).

class_id.description: From the model label table in models/ (agent-2). 0 = unknown.

species.description: JSON only. Lower-case label for class_id, filled in by pod-uplink from the label table so the ground station never needs it. 'unknown' for class_id 0.

thumb_path.description: Optional. Thumbnail file name relative to the Pod log dir; omit if none (C side: empty string). Thumbnail bytes are not sent in v1.

loc_source.description: JSON only, required whenever lat/lon are present. The dashboard labels 'simulated' openly.

heartbeat.description: Pod health, sent about every 10 s. JSON form of pod_heartbeat_t. The dashboard health panel reads only this.

queue_depth.description: Events logged but not yet acked.

last_ack_seq.description: Highest event seq the Pod has seen acked. 0 = none yet.

event_batch.description: Body of POST /api/events. Up to 50 events from ONE pod, in ascending seq order (gaps allowed; a gap just means those events come in a later batch).

pod_id.description: Must equal pod_id inside every event.

event_ack.description: Response of POST /api/events (HTTP 200). acked_seq is the highest seq S such that the ground station holds EVERY event 1..S for this pod (highest contiguous, not highest seen), so an event lost mid-batch is never skipped. pod-uplink advances its cursor to acked_seq and resends anything after it. A 4xx means the batch was malformed and nothing in it was stored.

stored.description: New events stored from this batch.

heartbeat_ack.description: Response of POST /api/heartbeat (HTTP 200). Body of the request is one heartbeat object. Also returns acked_seq so the Pod can resync its cursor after a reboot without sending events.
